name: GNO
summary: GNO continued GALLEX solar-neutrino measurements at Gran Sasso with upgraded extraction and counting procedures. Its multi-year programme tested the time-averaged low-energy electron-neutrino capture rate across a substantial part of a solar cycle.
detection_principle: Gallium-71 captures electron neutrinos to produce germanium-71. The product is chemically extracted from the gallium-chloride target and detected through low-level decay counting after each exposure.
